A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Choose supported attacks versus attacks cutting support elsewhere; infer whether competing faction defends or expands. A feint can matter without winning its destination. New army location changes next season options.

Take a seat
How to play
Nine-region planar map, each of three factions with two armies and two supply centers; one human, two bots. Each spring/autumn secretly order every army Hold, Move adjacent, or Support a specified army holding or attacking a region adjacent to the supporter. Simultaneous strength = one + uncut support; equal attacks bounce, swaps bounce, circular moves resolve. Any enemy attack from a region other than supported destination cuts support even if attack bounces. Dislodged army retreats to vacant allowed adjacent region or disbands. After autumn, centers set army count.
Control five of nine centers at an autumn count wins; after eight years most centers wins, ties draw.
